summary.intent: Run the full GSD discuss-phase → plan-phase → ui-phase workflow for Phase 21 (BYO-IPFS Node Support), capturing implementation decisions and creating all planning artifacts (CONTEXT.md, RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, UI-SPEC.md).
summary.outcome: All Phase 21 planning artifacts were created and consolidated onto a single branch (`docs/phase-21-context`) with a PR open (#346). Planning itself (plan-phase) was not re-run after ui-phase completed, so PLAN.md files do not yet exist.

repo: Phase 21 BYO-IPFS architecture shifted from server-relay dual-pin (PROJECT.md v1.1 plan) to client-direct SDK pinning with three user-selectable modes: CipherBox only, External only, Dual-pin.
Credentials for external IPFS nodes are stored in vault metadata on IPFS, encrypted with user key — zero-knowledge is preserved because the server never sees auth tokens.

TEE (Phala Cloud) is the right vehicle for pin migration background jobs: client provides CID list + encrypted source/dest configs, TEE decrypts in-enclave, migrates opaque encrypted blobs, never sees plaintext.
The existing IpfsProvider interface and RemotePin SDK layer are the integration points for BYO-IPFS; a new RemotePinningProvider implementation slots in without changing vault service logic.
ROADMAP.md success criteria SC#2 and BYO-02 need updating to reflect the revised three-mode pinning model and client-direct architecture.
PSA (IPFS Pinning Service API) and Kubo RPC both need to be supported, with auto-detection during the connection test in Settings UI.
Quota tracking becomes advisory only for external-only mode — no enforcement, just CID registration for visibility.

code.finding: Existing IpfsProvider interface is the extension point for adding a RemotePinningProvider for BYO-IPFS.
Local provider is the reference implementation pattern for the new external provider.
SettingsPage is where the new STORAGE tab (BYO-IPFS config, connection test, migration progress) will be added.
PinnedCid entity will need a new field to track which node(s) a CID is pinned to (CipherBox / external / both) for migration state tracking.
ADVISORY badge had `padding: 2px 6px` which violates the 4px grid system; fixed to `padding: 4px 8px`. The checker caught this in Dimension 5 twice before the orchestrator made the direct edit.

workflow: GSD ui-phase should be run on the same branch as discuss-phase and plan-phase — all planning artifact steps belong on one phase branch, not separate branches per step.

When the ui-phase spawns its own researcher agent, it does not automatically inherit the current git branch; the orchestrator must explicitly ensure it stays on the correct branch or the agent commits to wherever HEAD is.

The ui-phase revision loop (max 2 sub-agent iterations) may not converge if the issue is a simple literal value; the orchestrator can directly edit UI-SPEC.md after iteration 2 rather than spawning a third revision agent.

After ui-phase completes, plan-phase must be re-run (not assumed complete) — the UI-SPEC gate in plan-phase only fires if UI-SPEC.md is missing; once it exists the gate passes and planning proceeds normally.

Branch consolidation via `git merge` + branch deletion is the right recovery when two branches diverge unnecessarily during a single workflow run — all commits should land on one branch before creating a PR.

friction: GSD ui-phase created commits on a new branch (`docs/phase-21-ui-spec-revision`) instead of staying on the existing phase branch (`docs/phase-21-context`), requiring a manual merge and branch cleanup.

UI-SPEC checker blocked on Dimension 5 (spacing) twice — a `2px 6px` padding value — even after the researcher revision agent ran, because the agent didn't fix it precisely enough. Required a direct orchestrator edit.
